item.text:
I've fixed the `merge_intervals` function in `solution.py` to meet the requirements. The function now:

- Sorts intervals by their start time
- Merges overlapping or touching intervals
- Preserves isolated zero-length intervals
- Raises a `ValueError` for any interval where start > end
- Returns an empty list for empty input
- Does not mutate the input list

The implementation handles all edge cases and follows the specified behavior.
